threshold_note: Thresholds are tunable coach heuristics from reviewed recordings, not game rules. Every reason is stated only when the screenshots showed it. souls_at_death 1200: rec5 died twice with 1,229 and 3,467 unspent, both called out by the human review.
roles_note: Small hand-kept table for hero-specific lessons; heroes not listed get the generic lesson. Ranged = long-range weapon heroes whose job is to shoot from behind the front line.

roles.melee_items_note: Items whose description (data/items.json) starts with a melee attack: no use to a long-range hero (rec8 offered Lifestrike to Grey Talon).
roles.frontline_note: Frontliners (tanks and brawlers who stand in front of the team): when one of them falls first the fight is lost (rec13: 'Bebop and Rem are down, back out now'). Hand-kept list of hero class names.
